## Environment

- **OS**: (e.g. Windows 11 Pro 24H2, Ubuntu 24.04, Android 14, WASM in Firefox 133)
- **Qt version**: (e.g. 6.11.0)
- **OpenTodo version / commit**: (output of `git rev-parse --short HEAD` or release tag)
- **Build type**: Release / Debug / Pre-built
- **Compiler**: (e.g. MinGW 13.1, GCC 13, Clang 18, MSVC 19.40)

## Logs and screenshots

Paste relevant console output, stack traces, or screenshots. For sync-related issues, the `local_log/` directory contents and `state.json` (with any sensitive data redacted) are especially useful.

## Additional context

Anything else worth knowing — frequency, workaround, when it started, whether it survived a clean rebuild, etc.
